name: Element not found / locator changed
messageRegex: .*(NoSuchElement|Element not visible|Element not clickable|Element not present|None of the elements became visible).*

name: Appium session / device problems
messageRegex: .*(Could not create an Appium session|SessionNotCreated|No Appium session|session is either terminated|instrumentation process|adb).*

name: Backend / network unavailable
messageRegex: .*(could not fetch locations|backend unreachable|Something went wrong).*
